arithmetic_escalation.name: exact-source
arithmetic_escalation.admission: MC-003 exact integer/rational/algebraic/symbolic-turn source semantics apply
arithmetic_escalation.success: retain exact source values and exact finite piece boundaries
arithmetic_escalation.failure: advance only to a semantics-preserving stronger decision route; never decimalize or infer lost precision

arithmetic_escalation.name: exact-algebraic
arithmetic_escalation.admission: the current event/material predicate is reducible to the MC-006 semialgebraic calculus with all theorem hypotheses verified
arithmetic_escalation.success: use finite exact QE/CAD/root decisions and exact algebraic representations
arithmetic_escalation.failure: do not approximate the predicate sign; dispatch to a proved analytic route or a proof blocker

arithmetic_escalation.name: validated-directed-enclosure
arithmetic_escalation.admission: MC-007 proves separation or transversality and supplies an input-derived finite stopping/isolation bound
arithmetic_escalation.success: use outward directed enclosures plus justified derivative bounds until the certified stopping witness is reached
arithmetic_escalation.failure: if separation/transversality/stopping proof is absent, terminate as A3

arithmetic_escalation.name: fail-closed-proof-blocker
arithmetic_escalation.admission: a required equality/topology/source event is not covered by A0-A2 with proved preconditions
arithmetic_escalation.success: emit a typed unresolved proof blocker and preserve the case in the denominator
arithmetic_escalation.failure: not applicable; A3 is the finite truthful terminal state

finite_progress.subject: finite-journal composition
finite_progress.strict_progress: a successful composition step consumes exactly one next journal operation without dropping or reordering it
finite_progress.terminal: i=n or an explicit proof blocker/refusal

finite_progress.subject: MC-006 exact algebraic decision
finite_progress.domain: every event admitted by the checked MC-006 semialgebraic hypotheses
finite_progress.measure: the finite algorithmic decomposition/quantifier-elimination work prescribed by the inspected terminating exact procedure
finite_progress.strict_progress: progress is supplied by the referenced exact algorithm, not by a timeout counter
finite_progress.terminal: certified exact decision; resource refusal remains unsolved

finite_progress.subject: MC-007 separated/transversal analytic refinement
finite_progress.domain: every analytic event with a proved input-derived finite enclosure/isolation depth N
finite_progress.measure: N-k, a natural number after k certified refinement steps
finite_progress.strict_progress: each certified refinement increments k and preserves outward enclosure

finite_progress.subject: uncovered required event
finite_progress.domain: every required case lacking the preconditions of FP-008-02/03 or another proved finite route
finite_progress.measure: zero refinement steps after the missing premise is identified
finite_progress.strict_progress: fail closed immediately rather than retry, jitter or subdivide indefinitely
finite_progress.terminal: typed PROOF_BLOCKER retained in the denominator

error_composition.certifying_scalar_language: exact nonnegative rational/real-algebraic values or outward directed rational intervals; no binary-float predicate authority
error_composition.rule: For certified numeric stages, compose outward error enclosures monotonically from inherited bound plus a proved local contribution/transfer. If any required component is unknown, final numeric certification is UNCERTIFIED rather than zero, guessed or tolerance-clipped.
